habitat: 14-predictor forest including EPA sewershed coverage; 715 fitting counties; 72 fixed random holdout counties
score: Predicted 1 - P(free); used for white-to-hue shading in every county, including unreached counties
burden_scaling: Annual transport mean = 20 * start-of-year reached county count / 877
origin_feedback: Earlier nidi and their spread contribute origins beginning the next year
source_hue: Earliest arrival source, relative to natural-only counterfactual
metric_note: Rounded defaults use 0/16/40/80 km/year. Historical accepted reference retains its original speed units in provenance/historical_accepted_scenario_reference.json.

transport_distance.note: Curve probabilities are discretized into eight routing bands; eligible routes and empty-band fallback can alter the assigned distance distribution.

volume_note: Event frequency sets the national rate; normalized Interstate length allocates origins/destinations.
dropoff_map: Cumulative probability of at least one infectious delivery by selected year; no habitat threshold applied.
qa: 11 Python tests and Node map checks passed; headless Chromium verified both maps, live controls, sliders, downloads, methods, expert capture and mobile layout.
